title: Villa Belvedere | KEY.co
description_expanded: As the residence unfolds from one floor to the next, the second floor stands out as the vibrant core of the home. It features wooden ceiling beams, lavish furnishings, and breathtaking water views that captivate and delight. The expansive living room with its plush seating is perfect for gatherings, while the stylish dining area and state-of-the-art gourmet kitchen cater to every culinary need. The seamless integration of indoor and outdoor living is facilitated by large sliding glass doors that open to reveal a private, optionally heated pool, setting the stage for a truly serene retreat. With additional luxury offerings like a third-floor sitting area with a TV and beverage refrigerator and multiple balconies offering stunning vistas, Villa Belvedere isn’t just a place to stay—it's a premier destination for making lasting memories in an exquisite setting. Villa Belvedere, a stunning architectural gem, ushers in a new era of luxury in Seagrove Beach with its impeccably designed spaces and high-end finishes. This remarkable home boasts seven bedrooms and eight bathrooms, all crafted to offer unparalleled comfort and style for up to 16 guests. The use of exquisite marble countertops, professional-grade artwork, and sophisticated design elements throughout the residence exemplifies a commitment to luxury without compromise. Each room, from the airy and welcoming first-floor entryway to the plush guest bedrooms, is thoughtfully arranged to enhance the vacation experience, ensuring ample privacy and comfort.

Features: Elevator Internet Washer TV Gourmet kitchen
